scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate dev && pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy && pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:push: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push && pnpm db:generate

scripts.db:reset:force: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate reset --force && pnpm db:generate
scripts.db:init: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push --force-reset --accept-data-loss && pnpm build && dotenv -e ../../.env -- tsx prisma/seed-minimal.ts
